Why Kazakhstan is the Gulf's favourite summer escape

Four to five hours from the Gulf, visa-free for GCC citizens, with 25°C summers, snow-capped mountains thirty minutes from the city, halal food everywhere and prices well below Europe. Almaty is the green, mountain-ringed former capital; Astana is the futuristic new capital on the steppe. Read why Kazakhstan is the summer destination Gulf families look for and the best things to do in Kazakhstan 2026.

Where to go

  • Almaty: Medeu ice rink, Shymbulak cable car, Kok-Tobe hill, Big Almaty Lake and the Green Bazaar. See the Almaty guide and the best hotels in Almaty 2026.
  • Nature day trips from Almaty: Charyn Canyon, Kolsai and Kaindy lakes, Turgen waterfalls and the Assy plateau. See the 10 most important tourist attractions in Kazakhstan.
  • Astana: Baiterek Tower, Khan Shatyr, the Hazrat Sultan Mosque and the National Museum.
  • Beyond: Turkistan's mausoleum of Khoja Ahmed Yasawi, Shymkent and the Caspian coast; see the seven cities of Kazakhstan.

Sample itineraries

  • 6 days: Almaty with two nature day trips. See the Kazakhstan 6-day tour.
  • 7 days: Almaty (4) → Astana (2) by domestic flight, plus one lake day. See the one-week Kazakhstan itinerary and family trips in Kazakhstan with a 7-day program.
  • 10 days: Almaty, Kolsai lakes overnight, Astana, and Turkistan by high-speed train.

Best time to visit

Mid-May to mid-September is ideal: 25–32°C in Almaty, cooler in the mountains, all roads and lakes open. June to August is the Gulf family season; May and September are cheaper and quieter. December to February means skiing at Shymbulak and snow activities; see winter tourism in Kazakhstan and Almaty in winter. Avoid November and March, and check festivals and public holidays 2026 for Nauryz on 21–23 March.

What a family trip costs

For a family of four on a 7-day private program with 4-star hotels, a car with driver and an Arabic-speaking guide, expect roughly 2,500–3,800 USD in summer and 1,900–3,000 USD in spring and autumn, excluding international flights. Details in the cost of tourism in Kazakhstan.

Visa and practical notes

  • Citizens of Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman enter visa-free for up to 30 days. Details in travel procedures to Kazakhstan 2026.
  • The currency is the tenge; cards work almost everywhere, and Kaspi QR payments are universal for locals.
  • Halal food is the norm (Kazakhstan is Muslim-majority); see traditional dishes of Kazakhstan.
  • Bring a light jacket even in July for the mountains; see tips for moving and staying in Kazakhstan.

Frequently asked questions

Is Kazakhstan safe for families?
Yes. Almaty and Astana are safe, orderly cities with low crime, and road trips are made with licensed drivers.

Do guides speak Arabic?
Yes. Arcadia's Almaty office provides Arabic-speaking guides and drivers, as well as English-speaking guides.

Can Kazakhstan be combined with Uzbekistan?
Yes. A 10-day Almaty–Tashkent–Samarkand–Bukhara route is one of our most popular combinations; see tourism in Uzbekistan.

How far in advance should we book?
Eight weeks for June to August, four weeks in other seasons.
